scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User lands on the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the product name 'MirDB' and logo are prominently displayed
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Check that the tagline 'A persistent key-value store with Memcached protocol support' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate the product's purpose

steps.description: Check that primary CTA 'Get Started' and secondary CTA 'View on GitHub' are present and functional
steps.context: CTAs should be visually distinct and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is visible in the hero section
Tagline contains 'persistent key-value store' and 'Memcached protocol'
User is navigated to documentation or quick start section
User is navigated to the GitHub repository in a new tab

test_cases.input: Check hero section renders within viewport
test_cases.expected: Hero content is fully visible without scrolling on standard desktop viewport (1280x720)

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify all key features are displayed with accurate descriptions highlighting MirDB's capabilities

steps.description: Scroll or click to navigate to the key features section
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible from hero

steps.description: Check that all 5 key features are displayed: Memcached Protocol Compatibility, Disk Persistence, LSM Tree Architecture, Async Networking, Configurable Parameters
steps.context: Each feature should have a title and description

steps.description: Ensure each feature description accurately reflects MirDB's capabilities
steps.context: Descriptions should be technically accurate and user-friendly

test_cases.expected: Feature card/section displays 'Memcached Protocol' with description mentioning compatibility with standard memcached clients
Feature card/section displays 'Persistence' with description mentioning SSTables and durability

test_cases.input: Check for LSM Tree Architecture feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card/section displays 'LSM Tree' with description mentioning multi-level compaction
Feature card/section displays async networking with Tokio reference
Feature card/section displays configurable performance parameters

test_cases.input: Count total number of feature items
test_cases.expected: Exactly 5 key features are displayed in the section
